movelist.name: Gust
movelist.effect: If the target is airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop, Gust can hit them, ignoring Range and has a Damage Base of 8 instead.

movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

movelist.name: Minimize
movelist.effect: The user gains +4 Evasion, and user’s size is lowered to Small for the remainder of the encounter.

movelist.name: Constrict
movelist.effect: Constrict lowers the target’s Speed 1 Combat Stage. Constrict may be used as a Swift Action against targets the user is Grappling, and automatically hits when performed this way.

abilities.name: Unburden
abilities.effect: The default state of the user’s Speed is +2 Combat Stages. While holding a Held Item, the user’s Speed is lowered by 2 Combat Stages.
